claim_scope: single-seed online same-distribution VDA4 competence test; not transfer or held-out evidence
hypothesis: Increasing the total JEPA coefficient slightly while sharpening teacher prototype targets will strengthen task-relevant H1/H2 temporal structure enough to improve policy learning.
rationale: The failed modern gamma-0.95 run remained behaviorally near chance while H1/H2 prototype CE stayed only modestly below uniform and H2 weakened late. Lower teacher tau makes assignments closer to one-hot; a 20% JEPA-weight increase gives those sharper temporal targets slightly more optimization influence.
bundle_note: These two linked JEPA changes are intentionally bundled by user direction. A positive result would require a later ablation to attribute causality between weight and temperature.
developmental_learning_principle: Representation learning first, value learning second, motor/policy learning last.
behavior_cloning: disabled; the alpha-zero pure-MPO path does not construct a BC loss
falsification: Long-window correctness remains near 50%, best rolling correctness fails to exceed the prior 57.75% modern-run peak and 64-67% older baseline range, theta never decreases, or sharper targets cause prototype/representation collapse.

architecture.visual_feedback: source-RMSNorm and QK-normalized crossattn1: Q=X; K/V=[X,H1_prev] under one inspectable softmax
architecture.memory1: source-RMSNorm; four-head QK-normalized attention; gated output; raw H1 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.memory2: source-RMSNorm; four-head QK-normalized attention; gated output; raw H2 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.initial_memory: learned slot-distinct H1_0/H2_0 logits, tokenwise softmaxed before first use

jepa.cross_entropy: temporal student@t predicts detached EMA-teacher@t+1 independently for H1/H2
jepa.teacher_target_intent: lower entropy and closer to one-hot than the previous 0.04-to-0.07 schedule
jepa.center_update: EMA over valid timesteps only; padded tails excluded

collapse_prevention.sinkhorn_knopp: 3 iterations; balanced independently per memory-layer/token/head over valid batch-time samples

curriculum.update: theta=max(theta_floor, theta-3deg) only when window correctness>=0.85

monitoring.decision_rule: Behavior and curriculum advancement dominate JEPA CE; lower CE alone is not success.
